steps.instruction: Read route, backend application, quality verification, release, target, authority and digest-frozen migration plan. Confirm all source evidence binds one head, the target is non-production and the source-owned runner files match the plan.

calls.purpose: Read immutable migration and authority evidence.
Verify the frozen source head and runner provenance.

produces: Bound migration release identity and runner.

steps.instruction: Use the source-owned inspect command to read target journal state before mutation. Classify the entire frozen set as already applied, safely pending, missing, invalid, partial or uncertain. Only wholly safe pending work may proceed.

When and only when preflight proves the whole set safely pending, run the frozen source-owned apply command once. Do nothing for already-applied, partial, invalid or uncertain state. Never edit migration files or substitute a runner.

reads.when: only for a safely pending set

calls.purpose: Apply the exact frozen migration set once.

steps.instruction: Inspect the journal again after apply or any uncertain result, before considering another effect. Run replay inspection and prove no pending row, unchanged prior rows and exact checksums. Never reapply a present or partial row.

calls.purpose: Run post-apply and replay inspection without mutation.

steps.instruction: Compare plan, journal snapshots, apply output and replay. Produce exact defects and a release proof only when the set is wholly applied and history preserved; label already-applied as a proved no-op.

calls.purpose: Persist migration disposition and replay proof.

produces: Concrete failed-criterion feedback or passing review results.

steps.instruction: Write and validate the response with actual hashes, observations and review results. Never present partial or uncertain state as applied and never suggest blind reapplication.

calls.purpose: Present migration disposition and replay evidence.
